paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
notes: Upper limits to two-photon coupling of relic axions from optical emission line search in galaxy clusters Abell 2667 and 2390 (z≈0.23 and 0.23 respectively) using VLT-VIMOS integral-field spectroscopy. Mass range 4.5-7.7 eV constrained. Table I (page 9) provides limits at discrete masses derived from 95% confidence analysis of observed flux upper limits. Conversion: the paper's dimensionless parameter ξ is reported here as g_aγγ in GeV^-1 based on equations 8-10 and comparison with theoretical models (Figure 8). The weak limit at m_a=5 eV due to 5577Å sky emission line. Extraction confidence reduced due to ambiguity in ξ-to-g_aγγ conversion (not explicitly stated in paper).
